overview:
Catalight, formerly known as CG Consulting, is a Greater China-focused expert network headquartered in Hong Kong. Founded in 2010, the company has built deep coverage across mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, connecting global investors and consultancies with Chinese industry experts through bilingual (English/Mandarin) operations.

The company differentiates through its combination of expert consultations and industry events that connect investors with senior Chinese executives — a format particularly valued in the relationship-driven Chinese business culture. With 80,000+ experts focused primarily on Greater China markets, Catalight serves as a specialist complement to global networks for clients needing deep Chinese market intelligence.
